cases.description: Form T deposit on chain 714 with the recorded F14 calldata and value (the F14 flow itself is form A).
Smallest integers: nonce 0, tip 0, fee 1, value 1; one-character resource.
Integers at the RLP single-byte boundary: nonce, tip and value 127 (one byte), fee 128 (0x81 0x80).

Largest values the decoder accepts: nonce and gas 2^63-1, fees and value 2^256-1, a 2048-byte resource of every printable character. The extractor refuses it (EF3: deposit plus fee bound above 2^256-1).
Deposit plus fee bound exactly 2^256-1 (gas 21000, fee 1): the largest amount the facts can carry.
Deposit plus fee bound 2^256: the decoder accepts the bytes, the extractor refuses (EF3).
The tx_f14_714 deposit on the testnet 3735928814, to the CREATE2 copy of the escrow.
The tx_f14_714 deposit on the dev chain 31337, to the CREATE2 address; accepted only by an edictadev build.
